description: Pair-based pre/post LIF eligibility snapshots are modulated by discounted return advantages against a per-time-step baseline, then applied as bounded X updates.

learning.reward_signal: discounted return-to-go at each action minus a running baseline for that time step; baseline updates after the episode
learning.post_credit: Eligibility uses only the selected column, which must be an actual LIF spike and a WTA winner; unselected WTA winners receive no action credit.
learning.stdp_polarity: prior pre -> selected post: +A_plus; prior post -> current pre: -A_minus
learning.updates_applied_per_completed_episode: always when reward-modulated eligibility is nonzero
